The image displays multiple sequential panels containing hand-drawn illustrations of characters in action poses (including a figure in green armor and another in blue). Speech bubbles and caption boxes with text are visible within the panels. The paper appears to have a matte or semi-gloss texture typical of newsprint or standard comic paper.
